mapper.sql: SELECT a.id AS approval_id, a.action_request_id, a.status, a.version, a.requested_at, a.expires_at, ar.run_id, ar.customer_id, ar.action_type, ar.risk_level, ar.reason, ar.preview, c.name AS customer_name, coalesce(u.email::text, 'Agent') AS requester FROM approval a JOIN action_request ar ON ar.organization_id = a.organization_id AND ar.id = a.action_request_id JOIN customer c ON c.organization_id = ar.organization_id AND c.id = ar.customer_id LEFT JOIN organization_member m ON m.organization_id = a.organization_id AND m.id = a.requested_by_member_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id
mapper.update:
UPDATE approval SET status = #{status}, decided_by_member_id = #{deciderMemberId}, decision_comment = #{comment}, decided_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{approvalId} AND status = 'PENDING'
AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follow_up ( organization_id, customer_id, owner_member_id, agent_config_id, source_run_id, origin, status, due_at, priority, ai_score, score_version, score_breakdown, intent_level, risk_level, reason, recommended_action_type, recommended_action, evidence, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT ar.organization_id, ar.customer_id, nullif(ar.payload ->> 'ownerMemberId', '')::uuid, run.agent_config_id, ar.run_id, 'AI', 'OPEN', (ar.payload ->> 'dueAt')::timestamptz, (ar.payload ->> 'priority')::smallint, (ar.payload ->> 'aiScore')::smallint, coalesce(ar.payload ->> 'scoreVersion', 'sales-follow-up-v1'), jsonb_build_object('source', 'minimal-agent-workflow'), nullif(ar.payload ->> 'intentLevel', ''), nullif(ar.payload ->> 'riskLevel', ''), coalesce(nullif(ar.payload ->> 'reason', ''), ar.reason), coalesce(nullif(ar.payload ->> 'recommendedActionType', ''), 'ADD_NOTE'), coalesce(ar.payload -> 'recommendedAction', '{}'::jsonb), coalesce(ar.payload -> 'evidence', '[]'::jsonb), #{now}, #{now} FROM action_request ar JOIN agent_run run ON run.organization_id = ar.organization_id AND run.id = ar.run_id WHERE ar.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND ar.id = #{actionRequestId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM follow_up existing WHERE existing.organization_id = ar.organization_id AND existing.customer_id = ar.customer_id AND existing.origin = 'AI' AND existing.status IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'SNOOZED') )
mapper.update: UPDATE action_request SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', approved_at = coalesce(approved_at, #{now}), completed_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{actionRequestId}
UPDATE action_request SET status = 'REJECTED', completed_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{actionRequestId}

WITH approval_state AS ( SELECT ar.run_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'PENDING')::integer AS pending_count FROM action_request ar LEFT JOIN approval a ON a.organization_id = ar.organization_id AND a.action_request_id = ar.id WHERE ar.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND ar.run_id = #{runId} GROUP BY ar.run_id ) UPDATE agent_run run SET pending_approval_count = coalesce(state.pending_count, 0), status = CASE WHEN coalesce(state.pending_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'WAITING_APPROVAL' WHEN run.failed_count > 0 AND run.succeeded_count > 0 THEN 'PARTIALLY_COMPLETED' WHEN run.failed_count > 0 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END, output_summary = CASE WHEN coalesce(state.pending_count, 0) > 0 THEN run.output_summary ELSE jsonb_set( coalesce(run.output_summary, '{}'::jsonb), '{message}', to_jsonb('审批已全部处理，跟进任务已更新'::text), true ) END, completed_at = CASE WHEN coalesce(state.pending_count, 0) = 0 THEN CAST(#{now} AS timestamp with time zone) ELSE run.completed_at END, updated_at = CAST(#{now} AS timestamp with time zone), version = version + 1 FROM approval_state state WHERE run.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND run.id = #{runId} AND state.run_id = run.id
